question.text: Which clause BELOW is NOT among the listed challenges in conducting SIA per Chapter 7.4?

answer.text: Lack of standard use of terminologies
Unavailability of accurate and reliable data
A generic unrelated regulatory filing obligation

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 161-162 list the Chapter 7.4 challenges in conducting SIA as terminology, standardisation of reporting framework, common sector measures, accurate and reliable data, assumptions, interdependencies and timeframes. The other three options match items on that list, while the keyed option describes a generic regulatory filing obligation that is not enumerated as an SIA challenge in the workbook pages checked. The Trap: Unrelated regulatory filings can feel relevant to an SIA engagement, but they are compliance obligations rather than methodological challenges to conducting SIA. The workbook keeps the Chapter 7.4 list narrowly focused on the SIA process. Note: The original distractor Form 15CA was not found in the workbook pages checked, so it has been generalised to 'a generic unrelated regulatory filing obligation' to preserve the not-listed structure of the question.
